propositions: External actions in reconcile-bridge.yml workflow (which has contents and actions-write permissions plus OIDC capability) are not pinned to exact 40-character commit SHAs with readable version comments.
Makefile does not unconditionally include reconcile-bridge.yml in ZIZMOR_WORKFLOWS for zizmor security scanning, despite the workflow's privileged credential context.
The focused workflow pin test uses whitespace-truncated token extraction (\S+) and does not validate the complete uses: line including trailing readable version comments.
Zizmor scanning does not cover the privileged reconciliation workflow, leaving external action supply chain risks undetected.
The pin test contract must match complete uses: lines against the pattern uses:\s*\S+@([0-9a-f]{40})\s+#\s+[^\n]+$ to enforce both SHA and comment presence.
